newsitem.title: USA: Hanger Orthopedic files for 4.5 mln shrs.
newsitem.headline: Hanger Orthopedic files for 4.5 mln shrs.

text.p: Hanger Orthopedic Group Inc filed Friday with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission to offer up to 4.5 million common shares.
Underwriters for the offering, Alex. Brown & Sons Inc, Montgomery Securities and Legg Mason Wood Walker Inc, have an over-allotment option of up to 675,000 shares.
Proceeds from the sale will be used to repay outstanding debt, according to the filing. After the offering, the company will have 13,965,811 shares outstanding.
With headquarters in Bethesda, Md., Hanger owns orthopedic rehabilitation services, specializing in orthotics and prosthetics.
